name: Rizuhble's Stabby McStabface
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Getting poked out in lane. Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-5,600 (levels 1-11). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Bloodletting T1. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Compress Cooldown.

items.name: Mystic Regeneration
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Compress Cooldown completes 4,800 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Compress Cooldown completes 4.8k spirit in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Serrated Knives (2 to 3).

items.name: Radiant Regeneration
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Compress Cooldown completes 1,600 souls on. Upgrade of Mystic Regeneration (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.why: imminent: Compress Cooldown completes 4.8k spirit in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (4,000 to 5,600 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Slice and Dice: takes 18% off its 10s base cooldown.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 5,600-19,200 (levels 11-25). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Serrated Knives T3, Slice and Dice T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Slice and Dice, impact damage) grows from 134 to 235. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Spirit Shielding.

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spirit Shielding, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Spirit Shielding completes 1,600 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Spirit Shielding completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Grit
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Spirit Shielding completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Spirit Shielding completes 4.8k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Spirit Shielding
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Grit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Torment Pulse
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 5,600 to 8,800 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: component_for)

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 10,400 to 12,000 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. | With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 156s; 20% off is 31.2s per full rotation.

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Serrated Knives (5 to 6). Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Healbane
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus. | Temporary, sold when you buy Spirit Burn later.

items.name: Decay
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 14,400 to 17,600 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. | +8 spirit adds about 9.6 to Slice and Dice's impact damage (1.20x scaling).

items.name: Leech
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 32,000-49,600 (levels 30-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Bloodletting T3, Killing Blow T3.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 24,000 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Spirit Shielding? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Decay.
sections.desc: Dying after Spirit Shielding? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Decay.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry melts you when you dash in.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Their spirit damage keeps hurting you after the hit, like Infernus burn or Seven's ult.

items.name: Spellbreaker
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Big spirit bursts drop you before Bloodletting helps.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult or stun you can see coming.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Serrated Knives (channelled) and Slice and Dice (movement). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep catching you before you can dash.

items.name: Ethereal Shift
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They jump you and you've no dash left.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 36 to Slice and Dice's impact damage (1.20x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Replaces Enchanter's Emblem: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun. Takes vitality from 12,800 to 16,000 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
